ledgerSearch.outcome: The volume-04 voice card names any account of dissent as infection among the known weak passages, which governs the immune system material directly. CTD-0078 requires that the COINTELPRO and Tilly lineages not function as proof of a present threat. CTD-0055 requires that no defensive property be asserted as an accomplished fact. No item forbids the adaptive adversary analysis itself.

findings.summary: All four forms lost their mechanisms and their honest verdicts.

evidence.baseline: Patient, well-resourced actors place participants within Providence communities who are genuinely good participants, who contribute, who develop through the arc, who earn trust and stewardship roles, and whose long-term purpose is to shift the institution's behavior from within ... The honest account is that the architecture makes infiltration expensive and slow, not impossible.
evidence.shipped: Internal influence is one form. People may seek authority for private, commercial, political, or ideological ends. The response should be transparent decisions, distributed power, conflicts-of-interest rules, rotation, appeal, and evidence of conduct.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and the voice card's warning about dissent as infection.
findings.diagnosis: The shipped rewrite is a genuine safeguard against the card's known weak passage and its closing sentence, that suspicion based on identity, dissent, or intuition is not a safeguard, is better than anything in the baseline and is kept. What it also removed is the mechanism: an infiltrator who is a genuinely good participant, which is what makes the threat hard and the defense partial. Each of the four forms loses the same layer and its verdict.

findings.summary: The concession that each defense is partial was removed from all four.

evidence.baseline: diversification only helps if the sources are genuinely independent, and a sufficiently coordinated adversary can compromise the independence of multiple sources simultaneously. ... countering a reputational attack is always more expensive than mounting one.
evidence.shipped: Diversification helps only when dependencies are genuinely independent and exit remains practical.

findings.diagnosis: The chapter's opening says a complete defense against an adaptive adversary is a contradiction in terms, and the four concessions are what make that true rather than modest. The asymmetry of reputational defense is also a specific and checkable claim that the shipped version drops entirely.

debtImpact.note: The COINTELPRO reference is restored with the shipped qualifier that it is a real risk in some political contexts and does not justify designing around suspicion. Sourcing remains open.

generations.title: Derived from the immutable baseline under the thirteen rules

reasoning.note: R-LEDGER-WINS. The voice card's known weak passage on dissent as infection governs. Every shipped safeguard is kept: no suspicion by identity or dissent, criticism may reveal genuine harm, complainants protected, some legal pressure legitimate, no exemption from public law. The baseline mechanisms are restored inside those bounds.
R-PUNCT-STRUCT. Six em dashes. Four were parenthetical appositives and became comma pairs. Two introduced specifications of a defense and became commas.
All four forms with their mechanisms, the four partial-defense concessions, and the reputational asymmetry.

openQuestions: The restored infiltration passage describes patient actors placing participants who develop through the arc and earn stewardship. Held beside the shipped rule that suspicion by dissent is not a safeguard, the two are compatible but the tension is live, and it is exactly the tension the section's own second open question names.

The volume-04 voice card was prepared by the same pass that produced the shipped text, and its exemplar anchors and protected lines quote that text rather than the baseline. The card records `Author approved: pending tone, strategy, heading, and overcompression review`. The restoration keeps every line the card protects and otherwise follows the baseline, which means card and source now diverge in wording the card does not name. R-VOICE-BIND requires that the disagreement be raised rather than settled here: the card should be re-derived from whichever text the author approves.

Structural labels were frozen for this pass and none was touched. Every markdown heading, every standalone bold display line, every chapter label, and every all-capital display line is byte identical to its pre-edit state, in the same order, with the same blank-line separators on both sides. A label determines a section id, a section id is a public route, and `publishing/continuity/section-lineage.json` already records this volume's renames and resolves the historical routes. Changing one is a continuity decision and not an editorial one. Only the running prose between labels was restored. Where a baseline label names its section better than the current one, the cost is recorded here and the label is left alone.

regenerationTest.purpose: The rules must reproduce the section from the baseline without consulting the shipped text.
regenerationTest.method: Derived from the immutable baseline applying editorial/method/standard.md, the corpus voice card, the volume-04 voice card, and the debt ledger under R-LEDGER-WINS.
regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. This is the volume's most successful ledger paydown and its most costly compression in the same section: the card's concern was answered well and the analysis it was answering was removed. Keeping both is the whole of the restoration and it is why the section is longer than either version.

audits.auditor: editorial-agent, generation 2 of the twenty-rule re-render lane
audits.scope: Full re-read of the current section against the immutable baseline under all twenty rules. The original record was derived under the thirteen-rule index; this audit adds the substitution count and the later rules: R-LEDGER-WINS-COROLLARY, R-CORRECTION-SCOPE, R-CANON-DELETION-RECORD, R-PAIRED-DELETION, R-CAUTIOUS-HALF, R-SUBSTITUTION-CREDIT, and R-REFRAIN-COST.

substitutionTest.rule: R-CAUTIOUS-HALF, substitution form, run as standing procedure before any pairing test
substitutionTest.method: Normalize both texts, strip markup, split into sentences of three or more words, count baseline sentences appearing verbatim in the current section.
substitutionTest.note: Well above zero, so the section is a restoration, not a substitution, and the pairing test applies. Verbatim survival understates fidelity here: every R-PUNCT-STRUCT repair and recorded bounding changes the sentence it lands in, so the non-surviving remainder was read against the diff and attributed rather than assumed lost.

audits.checked: R-CAUTIOUS-HALF: each of the four forms keeps both its mechanism and its partial-defense concession, which is the section's own two-sided architecture, and every restored verdict keeps its committing half. R-PAIRED-DELETION: infiltration, upstream capture, reputational attack, and legal pressure were swept; the survival chapter answers them and all ends stand; COINTELPRO, Ward Churchill, and Jim Vander Wall re-verified intact in the lineage. R-CORRECTION-SCOPE: the recorded R-LEDGER-WINS class, every shipped safeguard kept under the card's dissent-as-infection concern, re-verified at width: each kept safeguard bounds a restored mechanism and none replaced one. R-LEDGER-WINS-COROLLARY re-run: the itemized safeguards plus three unitemized members of the same class, attributed below, were searched for in the immutable baseline and are not there; seeded with provenance now visible, bounding, no credit. R-SUBSTITUTION-CREDIT: nothing kept on merits, no credit owed, stated explicitly. R-CANON-DELETION-RECORD, R-REFRAIN-COST, R-TENSE, R-DEIXIS, R-NEGATION-STACK: nothing fires.
audits.conclusion: The restoration holds under the full twenty-rule index. Fourteen of twenty-four baseline sentences survive verbatim; the remainder are the ten em dash glyphs repaired across seven sites, the recorded safeguard class with its newly itemized members, and the semicolon separation, all attributed. No prose change required.
corrections: The original itemization is corrected: ten em dash glyphs across seven sites, not six. The contradiction dash stands as a period; the participants, defense, and reputational defense pairs stand as comma pairs; the upstream and reputation dashes stand as commas; and the impossible dash stands as a colon introducing the enumeration of legal pressures. The baseline's semicolon at not a hypothetical stands as a period, giving the documentation claim its own sentence.

Three unitemized members of the recorded safeguard class, none in the baseline, now attributed: the extension of the infiltration defense list with conflicts-of-interest rules and appeal; the compatible funder, vendor, or protocol sentence with the exit remains practical clause in the upstream form; and the legal competence, public accountability, and sovereignty language additions in the legal form. Each bounds a restored mechanism under the same card concern the record names; provenance now visible; bounding, no credit.
